§6Conveyors §rare a cheap logistics method in NTM, which allow you to move around items on conveyor belts.

To place them, you can simply§b right click §rand follow the ghost outline of the conveyor. If you wanna place them manually you can shift click, and you can change their direction using a screwdriver.

Conveyors §ccannot§r interface with inventories directly, and as such need a few separate blocks to interact with them:

§6Conveyor Inserters§r allow you to insert items into an inventory from a conveyor. The conveyor needs to be facing into the inserter in order to feed it. Inserters also void items if they're full by default, which may cause wastage of items.

§bConveyor Ejectors§r allow you to take items out of inventories to a conveyor. The conveyor does not need to face into our out of the ejector, it can be parallel to it. Ejectors can also be configured with various upgrades (Ejection Speed and Stack upgrades) and they can also use filters.

§9Conveyor Grabbers§r allow you to "grab" items off of conveyor belts running parallel to them, placing them in inventories. They can accept filters, and upgrades, as they only grab a certain amount of items and may miss some items if the conveyor is too full. They also can ignore items if the inventory they are inserting into is full. They do not have their own inventories, and they can grab from any direction.

§aConveyor Boxers/Unboxers§r allow you to package large amounts of items in boxes, and then unbox them back into items. 

§3Conveyor Sorters§r allow you to sort items into different directions based on various criteria.

§eConveyor Splitters§r allow you to split a single belt into two different belts, you can modify the ratio by right-clicking the respective side with a §6Screwdriver.§r

Conveyors can move up and down by default.

NOTE: Having too many items on a conveyor causes it to explode.

Conveyors also have §dmulti-lane§r variants, which have multiple tracks, and §2Express §rvariants, which move way faster.

&qFun Fact§r: Before, conveyor chutes and ramps used to be items you'd have to craft. Newgen NTM players should rejoice that this isn't as hard anymore!
